newsitem.title: USA: Boyd Gaming to issue $250 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Boyd Gaming to issue $250 mln in notes.

text.p: Boyd Gaming Corp said it plans to issue $250 million of 10-year senior subordinated notes pursuant to a private placement.
It said it plans to use the net proceeds of the offering to refinance outstanding indebtedness.

The securities to be offered will not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or applicable state securities laws, and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration under the Securities Act and applicable state securities laws or available exemptions from the registration statements.
